title: (chore) O3-5965: Remove inert Carbon CSS rules from reports app
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary
Removes four `width: 100%` rules in `reports.scss` targeting `.cds--date-picker`, `.cds--select`, `.cds--select-input`, and `.cds--date-picker__input`. These selectors lack `:global()`, so CSS Modules rewrites their class names and they never match Carbon's actual markup — the rules have never had any effect. This is a behavior-preserving dead code removal.

Verified via:
- Grep confirms no `cds--` class names remain in the file
- Production build passes
- Existing test and lint suites pass unchanged

## Screenshots
Not applicable — no visual or behavioral change, since the removed rules were already inert.

## Related Issue
https://issues.openmrs.org/browse/O3-5965

## Other
No new tests added intentionally: the deleted rules had no effect, so there is no new behavior to cover. A clean production build is the verification that no rendering depended on them.
